mean_dynamic_topography_source: DTU22MDT at Bãi Trước (report 0009, D-0009-07 and section 6.4): the mean sea level is 1.16 m over EGM2008. The heights over EGM2008 (Copernicus, GEDTM30, DeltaDTM, the lidar, ATL24) take it away, so the land and the sea of the tide have one zero: the mean sea level.
